picks.what: The Church of Saints Michael and Theodore across a pond, photograph
picks.why: only usable modern city view; yellow church reflected in the water, trimmed to the middle of the wide panorama

notes: #1 is the Desna in Koropskyi district, not the city. #3 is a distorted 360° panorama of Red Square, too narrow to crop. #4 is a riverbank with no city in view. #2 does not show the city’s best-known landmarks (the Val, Transfiguration Cathedral); replace if a better modern view turns up.
